claims.sourceText: American Alchemy - Jake Barber interview, 30 January 2025
claims.text: Jake Barber, a former special operations pilot, described participation in UAP retrieval operations in a January 2025 on-camera interview, and gave his account by name.

edges.label: Michels published Barber's crash-retrieval account
edges.note: Published 30 January 2025 to 1,010,989 views; Barber, a former intelligence officer, described helicopter-borne retrieval. Barber subsequently spoke at the 2025 Sol Foundation Symposium, moving from independent media into the institutional wing.

topics.title: The legacy programme allegation: retrieval, custody and reverse engineering
